The directive he of שָׁמָּה is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes *There*, which carries place but not direction, so nothing answers to the he. Rule 32's fusion cases (*thither*, *out*, *home*) are ones where the single English word does carry the direction.
The margin's *for all their might* is not the ASV text, so בְּ keeps its *in*.
